title: Relationship Addiction (Codependency)
description:
These daily affirmations are designed to support individuals healing from relationship addiction and
codependent patterns. Recovery is a journey of discovering your identity, developing healthy boundaries,
building emotional independence, and creating relationships rooted in mutual respect, trust, and
authenticity. These affirmations encourage self-worth, emotional resilience, self-compassion, and balanced,
healthy connections. They are intended to complement professional counseling, support groups, personal
reflection, and the encouragement of trusted family and friends.

safety.disclaimer: This programme complements counselling, hypnotherapy, EFT, and trusted accountability. It is not a medical cure.
safety.reminder:
Healing from relationship addiction and codependency is a journey of rediscovering yourself while
learning to build healthy, balanced relationships. It is not about becoming emotionally distant or
avoiding connection-it is about developing relationships where both people can thrive with mutual
respect, responsibility, and healthy boundaries. With the support of a qualified therapist, support

modules.title: Awareness & Commitment
focus: I recognize that my identity is separate from my relationships.
Healthy boundaries are acts of love toward myself and others.

modules.title: Healing & Self-Compassion
focus: I treat myself with kindness and patience.
I allow myself to receive love without losing myself.
I release guilt for prioritizing my well-being.

modules.title: Strength & Growth
focus: I trust others to take responsibility for their own choices.
My confidence grows every time I honor my values.

modules.title: Freedom & Purpose
focus: I build relationships based on mutual respect and healthy interdependence.
I value connection without sacrificing my identity.
I embrace a future filled with balance, authenticity, emotional freedom, and lasting peace.

activities.title: Closing affirmation and forward plan
activities.affirmation:
I am not defined by another person's approval, choices, or ability to love me. I am defined by my
character, my values, and my growing capacity to love myself with compassion and respect. Every
day I choose healthy boundaries, I strengthen my confidence, deepen my emotional freedom, and
create relationships built on trust, honesty, and mutual care. One choice, one conversation, and one
day at a time, I am creating a life of balance, self-worth, authentic love, and lasting fulfillment.

fields.label: What will you keep practising after this journey?
What support do you still want?
Share this closing plan with Gerald
